messages:
leila: opened a short PR that bundles streaming troubleshooting notes (429s mid-stream, stream timeouts, context-trim interactions) + tiny python/node snippets and a microsample harness. PTAL! :wave:

omar: link? want to sanity check guidance for when clients should retry vs resume. important we avoid recommending naive token-resend.

leila: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/845. I put the harness at examples/diagnostics/stream-troubleshoot and kept it dependency-free (uses local mock server).

viktor: quick review: please call out explicitly that resuming with a cursor is preferred and that customers should avoid re-sending the last N tokens unless they checkpoint an idempotent commit.

leila: yes — added a short pattern section: "checkpoint last-committed token id" + resumable cursor header. tiny pseudo snippet included: ```python
# resumable pattern (pseudo)
resp = client.stream(prompt, headers={"x-resume-cursor": cursor})
for ev in resp:
    if ev.cursor <= last_seen:
        continue
    out += ev.text
    last_seen = ev.cursor
```

omar: also add a sentence about cost: double-sending tokens inflates billed tokens. put a :warning: flag.

leila: added cost note and :warning:.

viktor: what about Retry-After mid-stream? do we say to stop reading and backoff, or to finish consuming then backoff? different SDKs may surface the header differently.

leila: I documented both behaviors: if server sends Retry-After as a response header at stream start, honor it before retrying; if mid-stream the server sends a trailer or abrupt abort, treat it as a signal to resume later with a cursor. included a tiny backoff snippet (exponential + jitter).

omar: can you paste the backoff snippet inline here so I can copy to our SDK quickstart?

leila: pasted in PR but also here: ```js
// simple backoff w/ jitter
const backoff = (attempt)=> Math.min(1000 * 2**attempt, 30000) * (0.5 + Math.random()/2);
await sleep(backoff(attempt));
```

viktor: CI? importer rules require node snippets under examples/snippets/node.

leila: moved node snippet to examples/snippets/node. also renamed header to `x-stream-cursor` to align with telemetry.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #845  link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1299.

omar: small content ask: add a short matrix that maps error-visible codes to probable causes (e.g., 429-sync = request rejected; mid-stream abort + 502 = upstream failure; stream aborted with no status = connection drop). keep it one paragraph.

leila: added a compact matrix paragraph under "How to interpret errors".

viktor: ops raised a Dedicated note: Dedicated pools may opt to queue instead of immediate 429; Private deployments may surface different network-level codes based on infra. Please add a sentence under "Deployment differences" and link to dedicated capacity docs.

leila: done. added Deployment differences and link to dedicated-capacity.

omar: editorial: use code spans for header names (e.g., `Retry-After`, `x-stream-cursor`) and prefer lowercase example header in snippets.

leila: fixed header formatting and updated examples. tiny migration blurb added: "SDKs that previously auto-reconnected for streams should provide an explicit resume API or disable implicit reconnects."

viktor: LGTM on content. leaving final style pass to anya.

anya: quick pass: a couple grammar nits and suggestion to add crosslink to error-ref 429 and the SDK retry docs. otherwise fine.

leila: incorporated edits and added crosslinks. ready for merge after CI. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #845 merged by anya at 1755004410.
